span.raw:
On March 21, 2016, Wheaton International entered into an early deposit precious
metal purchase agreement with Panoro Minerals Ltd. and its wholly owned subsidiary Cordillera Copper Ltd. (“Panoro”) (the “Cotabambas Early Deposit Agreement”) for the Cotabambas project located in Peru (the “Cotabambas
project”). Panoro and its subsidiaries have provided Wheaton with corporate guarantees and certain other security over their assets.
